criteria.requirement: Implement alive_progress.asyncio.alive_async_it(source,total=None,*,finalize=None,**bar_options) as a native async iterator using the real alive_bar handle and completed snapshots. Yield original items in order without prefetching, increment only when the consumer resumes past a yielded item, and invoke an explicit sync or awaitable finalizer exactly once only after normal exhaustion, including empty input/falsey callables. Early aclose, cancellation and source errors propagate/clean progress context without success finalization. Reject manual mode and invalid callbacks before reading the source; caller owns the source and rendering remains configured through original bar options.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
